rule.title: Only interest on a debt secured by a qualified home is home mortgage interest

when_missing.because: A home mortgage is secured by the home unless a preparer says otherwise

citation.wording: The mortgage is a secured debt on a qualified home in which you have an ownership interest.

rule.open_point: Interest on a rental's or a business's loan belongs on Schedule E or C through the activity's own record; this rule only stops it counting as home mortgage interest.
